Shakespeare as anti-Semite The racism in The Merchant of Venice is a sign of the Bard's biased times

Thursday, April 13, 1989

ROBERT CUSHMAN

BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Mr. Cushman was theatre critic of The Observer in London for 11 years. He now lives in Toronto and writes regularly on theatre for Saturday Night magazine. THAT OLD RACIST William Shakespeare is catching it again. The Stratford Festival has announced it will present what is, in Canada, his most notorious play this year, and the news is causing the customary concern.
